info.title: CuspFlow API
info.description:
REST API for a CuspFlow clinic, for the clinic's own IT/BI team and for inbound data
migration. Reads cover every core module; writes cover the clinical and reference records.
Money is readable but not writable in v1.

Full guide: https://cuspflow.co/docs/developers/api-overview

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer cfk_live_...`. A key is clinic-scoped, carries an
explicit scope set, and is bound to a staff role whose permissions it can never exceed.

**No CORS.** This API sends no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, deliberately. An API key in a
browser is a leaked API key; call it from a server.

**Pagination is keyset only.** Follow `meta.next_cursor`. There is no offset parameter.

**`billing` is the canonical money table.** `invoices`/`invoice_items` are dead schema and are
not exposed; do not build against them.

**`appointments.staff_id` is the assignee.** `dentist_id` and `doctor_id` are returned for
existing rows but are legacy and rejected in request bodies.

**Tolerate additions.** New fields, resources, optional parameters and enum values ship into v1
without a version bump. Unknown fields and unknown enum values must not break your client.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. `detail` never contains a field VALUE, because those are patient data.
